title: fix: keep agent tool calls renderable
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Always separate managed-agent tool blocks from surrounding Markdown
- Cover first-output tool results in streaming and non-streaming responses
- Fix Open WebUI intermittently showing raw tool-call details markup

Checks: `npx tsc --noEmit`

gist.headline: Tool calls, neatly planted
gist.blurb: Managed-agent tool blocks now get a little breathing room before meeting Markdown. Open WebUI can render the useful bits instead of occasionally displaying the plumbing.
gist.summary: Fixed managed-agent response formatting so tool blocks are always separated from surrounding Markdown, including first-output tool results in both streaming and non-streaming responses.
gist.impact: Open WebUI users will see consistently renderable tool calls rather than intermittent raw tool-call markup.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a meticulous little typesetter in a cozy garden-terminal, placing clear divider lines between glowing tool-call cards and Markdown scrolls. A happy CRT monitor robot reads the neatly rendered result while small code-plants grow from organized document trays.
